layout.arrangement: Figure-only slide. Maroon outer frame; yellow badge '52' upper-right; inner red frame around a white scatter plot (gray grid); blue U/parabola series, red cluster with two outliers, a vertical dark line at x=0, and a small black arrow near (-1,8) pointing down-left; black band along bottom.

visual_elements.description: Scatter plot, white bg #FFFFFF, grid #D9D9D9 (vertical x=-5,0,5,10,15,20; horizontal y=0..35 step 5), ticks/spines #7F7F7F, labels #404040; no legend; readable values = axis ticks only
Blue series #0000FF: upward-opening U/parabola, x~1-14, y~15-24; vertex ~(7.5,15), arms peak y~23-24 at x~1.5 and x~13.5
Red series #FF0000: dense cluster x~4-11, y~21-28, plus outliers ~(2.6,26.5) and ~(3.0,28)
Vertical line #333333 at data x=0, y~11 to ~31
Small black arrow near data (-1,8), pointing down-left

typography_notes: Generic sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica/DejaVu-like). Tick labels ~11 pt regular #404040, centered on ticks, '-5' with leading minus. Badge '52' ~15 pt black centered. No title/bold/italic.
